contract.authority: Play Cookie session plus exact Origin and release gates on every request
contract.identity: SHA256 namespace + authenticated UID + request key -> stable internal room ID
contract.persistence: private immutable creator UID and canonical parameter fingerprint in existing room aggregate
contract.conflict: HTTP 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT; never overwrite original room
contract.legacyClients: header optional; no idempotency guarantee is retroactively asserted for legacy unkeyed requests
